ok.definition: Share of question families whose questions were all judged correct (a family's value is the mean over its questions). Partial and incorrect count as not correct.

judge_only.note: The judge's mean over every unit; biased by the judge's own error.

warnings: Only 40 human-reviewed units: the interval is approximate below 100.

absent.definition: Share of question families whose questions were all judged correct (a family's value is the mean over its questions). Partial and incorrect count as not correct.

ragas.correctness.reason: No review sample was given. Draw one with `workbench review-sample`, have people review exactly those questions, and pass it with --sample.

judge_only.note: The judge's rate over the families it judged completely; biased by the judge's own error, and silent about families it did not judge.
